name: Zavtra opjat' po novoj....
source: The protagonist regains consciousness in an unknown place. Yet, every such awakening shares a strange peculiarity: he always wakes up in the shallows, feeling a strange and indescribable sensation running through his arm, asking himself the very same questions ("What am I doing here? Who is he? Why am I not wary of him? On the contrary, why do I feel I can trust him? Where is he leading me..?").
translation: 主角在一个未知的地方恢复了意识。然而，每一次这样的觉醒都有一个奇怪的特点：他总是在浅水处醒来，感觉一种奇怪的、难以形容的感觉穿过他的手臂，问自己同样的问题（“我在这里做什么？他是谁？为什么我对他不警惕？相反，为什么我觉得我可以信任他？他要把我带到哪里……？”）。
